sections.heading: Document body
paragraphs: Per the file, each tx that is submitted to (per the file) the Solana ledger imposes costs. Per the file, transaction fees paid by (per the file) the submitter, and collected by a node, in theory, acct for the acute, transactional, (per the file) costs of validating and (per the file) adding that data to the ledger. Per the file, unaccounted in this process (per the file) is the mid-term storage (per the file) of active ledger state, necessarily (per the file) maintained by the rotating node set.

Per the file, this type of storage (per the file) imposes costs not only to nodes but also to the (per the file) broader network as active (per the file) state grows so does (per the file) data transmission and validation overhead. Per the file, to acct for these costs, we (per the file) describe here our preliminary (per the file) design and implementation of storage rent. Per the file, storage rent may be paid via one (per the file) of two methods: Method (per the file) 1: Set it and (per the file) forget it With this approach, accts with two-years worth of (per the file) rent deposits secured are exempt (per the file) from network rent charges.

Per the file, by maintaining this minimum-balance, (per the file) the broader network benefits from (per the file) reduced liquidity and the acct holder can rest assured that (per the file) their Account::data is to be retained for continual access/usage. Per the file, method 2: Pay per byte If an acct has less than two-years (per the file) worth of deposited rent the (per the file) network charges rent on a (per the file) per-epoch basis, in credit for (per the file) the next epoch.

Per the file, this rent is deducted (per the file) at a rate specified (per the file) in genesis, in lamports per kilobyte-year. Per the file, for information on the (per the file) technical implementation details of (per the file) this design, see the Rent section. Those statements are the file’s claims, not a Sol.College measurement of a live cluster.
